factual_claims.claim: For the financial year ended June 30, 2025, SAF Tehnika Group’s performance improved substantially in profitability despite lower revenue.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Grupa noslēdza 2024./2025. finanšu gadu ar zaudējumiem 643 tūkstoši EUR apmērā. Iepriekšējā finanšu gada Grupas darbības rezultāts bija zaudējumi 2.37 miljoni EUR. Peļņas vai zaudējumu un pārējo visaptverošo ienākumu pārskatā redzams, ka bruto peļņa palielinājās no 7.53 miljoniem EUR uz 9.50 miljoniem EUR, bet operacionālie zaudējumi samazinājās no 3.22 miljoniem EUR uz 1.29 miljoniem EUR.

factual_claims.claim: Consolidated revenue decreased by 4% to EUR 25.99 million from EUR 27.09 million, while the parent company’s revenue declined by 6% to EUR 21.92 million.

factual_claims.source_evidence: Grupas neto apgrozījums 2024./2025. finanšu gadā bija 25.99 miljoni EUR, kas ir par 1.1 miljonu EUR jeb par 4% zemāks kā iepriekšējā 2023./2024.finanšu gadā. Mātes sabiedrības neto apgrozījums 2024./2025. finanšu gadā bija 21.92 miljoni EUR, kas ir par 1.33 miljoniem EUR jeb par 6% zemāks nekā iepriekšējā 2023./2024.finanšu gadā.

factual_claims.claim: The main pressure came from the Americas, where revenue fell by 14% to EUR 14.17 million, representing 55% of Group revenue.

factual_claims.source_evidence: Amerikas reģiona, kas aptver realizāciju Ziemeļamerikā, Dienvidamerikā un Centrālamerikā, apgrozījums 2024./2025. finanšu gadā bija 14.17 miljoni EUR, kas veido 55% no Grupas kopējā apgrozījuma. Salīdzinot ar iepriekšēvo 2023./2024. finanšu gadu, apgrozījums šajā reģionā samazinājās par 2.3 miljoniem EUR jeb 14%.

candidate_sentences.text: The main pressure came from the Americas, where revenue fell by 14% to EUR 14.17 million, representing 55% of Group revenue.

candidate_sentences.text: Management attributed the decline largely to the timing of large projects, customer caution over investment decisions, and uncertainty surrounding tariff changes.

factual_claims.claim: European revenue increased by 17% to EUR 10.0 million, partly offsetting the decline, while revenue in Asia, Africa, and the Middle East decreased by 5% to EUR 1.8 million.

factual_claims.claim: The Group continued investing in product development and its microwave transmission, Spectrum Compact, and Aranet IoT product lines.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Pārskata gadā tika turpināta jaunu produktu izstrāde, kā arī uzsākts darbs pie ātrāk īstenojamām produktu attīstības iniciatīvām. details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, and K5 are fully represented with clear coverage in the candidate summary. K6 (segment and geographic revenue distribution) is missing entirely - no mention of the two business segments or export percentages. K7 (loss explanation and outlook) is missing - while there is some mention of management outlook, the specific characterization of the loss as temporary and not impacting long-term stability is absent. K8 (proposal to cover loss) is missing entirely - there is no mention of using retained earnings to cover the loss. Therefore, while most core financial performance and operational details are present, the missing strategic context and loss coverage proposal constitute important omissions that prevent a 'Yes' rating.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements are logically connected and support the overall narrative of improved profitability despite revenue decline. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational issues. The summary flows logically from revenue performance to profitability metrics, cash flow, investments, and concludes with auditor opinion. While there is a minor arithmetic relationship between segment revenues and consolidated revenue (S2-S5), the candidate does not claim these are exhaustive additive components of the same total, so this does not constitute a contradiction per evaluation guidelines. The structure is clear with each sentence building upon the previous information.
